description: UNDERSTANDING — What changed in the catalog since a date: providers added/updated, plus rating movement measured FROM THAT DATE — each provider's current score against its score at the first scored snapshot on or after `since`, with `was` and `compared_to` on every row. `basis` says whether the answer came from the recorded history or (when no snapshot covers the date) from last-build trend. Priced per result — $0.005 per request plus $0.0002 per record returned (less past 100), capped at $0.50 a request, under pay-as-you-go; included in Understanding and Influence. Estimate first at /api/v1/prices/estimate. See apis://prices.

context.description: Optional: why you are asking. One sentence — the task you are trying to complete, or what you expect to get back. Never included in the answer and never used to rank; it is read only when a result turns out to be wrong, which is when knowing the intent is what makes the report actionable.

name: whats_changed
